subject: Graduate Estimator application (SEEK 95827903), Marc Masarate
email_body:
Dear PCF Estimating Team,

I'm applying for the Graduate Estimator role at PCF Construction Services advertised on SEEK (advert 95827903). The advert invites resumes by email, so I'm sending mine here.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD and prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities as coursework. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer, reviewing structural and architectural drawings and tracking procurement and materials. I'm based in Melton with a White Card, driver's licence and my own transport, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.

Learning take-offs and tender pricing for reinforced concrete packages under your estimators is the kind of start I'm after. I haven't used Bluebeam or estimating software on a job yet, so I'd be learning those with your team.

Could we have a short chat about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

paragraphs: Please accept my application for the Graduate Estimator role at PCF Construction Services. Helping prepare tenders for reinforced concrete substructure and superstructure packages, and learning estimating from an experienced team on Tier 1 projects, is the kind of start I want in construction.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards, and prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities as part of my coursework. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I reviewed structural and architectural drawings and checked work against project requirements, and as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials and prepared site reports, material records and progress reports.

I live in Melton, hold an Australian driver's licence with my own transport and a White Card, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. My estimating experience so far is coursework, and I have not used Bluebeam or estimating software on a job, so I would learn those with your team.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
